_NGINX_LINE_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?P<ip>\S+)\s+-\s+(?P<user>\S+)\s+"
    r"\[(?P<ts>[^\]]+)\]\s+"
    r'"(?P<req>(?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"\s+'
    r"(?P<status>\d{3})\s+(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+"
    r'"(?P<ua>(?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"\s+'
    r"rt=(?P<rt>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+uct=(?P<uct>-|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$"
)


def parse_nginx_upstream_line(line: str) -> NginxAccessRow:
    m = _NGINX_LINE_RE.match(line.rstrip("\r\n"))
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("malformed nginx upstream log line")

    req_parts = m.group("req").split(" ")
    if len(req_parts) != 3:
        raise ValueError("malformed HTTP request triple")
    method, target, proto = req_parts

    raw_user = m.group("user")
    raw_uct = m.group("uct")

    return NginxAccessRow(
        client_ip=m.group("ip"),
        remote_user=None if raw_user == "-" else raw_user,
        time_local=m.group("ts"),
        method=method,
        target=target,
        protocol=proto,
        status=int(m.group("status")),
        body_bytes=int(m.group("bytes")),
        user_agent=m.group("ua").replace('\\"', '"'),
        request_time_s=float(m.group("rt")),
        upstream_connect_s=None if raw_uct == "-" else float(raw_uct),
    )
```

_WS_RE = re.compile(r"\s+")
_FROM_RE = re.compile(r"\bfrom\s+([^\s();]+)", re.IGNORECASE)
_BY_RE = re.compile(r"\bby\s+([^\s();]+)", re.IGNORECASE)


def parse_received_hops(raw_email: bytes) -> list[ReceivedHop]:
    msg = BytesHeaderParser(policy=policy.default).parsebytes(raw_email)
    raw_headers = msg.get_all("Received", [])
    hops: list[ReceivedHop] = []

    for hdr in reversed(raw_headers):
        unfolded = _WS_RE.sub(" ", str(hdr)).strip()
        if ";" not in unfolded:
            raise ValueError("Received header missing ';' date delimiter")
        routing_part, date_part = unfolded.rsplit(";", 1)
        dt = parsedate_to_datetime(date_part.strip())
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        ts_unix = int(dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).timestamp())

        m_from = _FROM_RE.search(routing_part)
        m_by = _BY_RE.search(routing_part)
        hops.append(
            ReceivedHop(
                from_host=m_from.group(1) if m_from else None,
                by_host=m_by.group(1) if m_by else None,
                timestamp_unix=ts_unix,
            )
        )

    return hops

def parse_proxy_v2_header(buf: bytes) -> ProxyV2Header:
    if len(buf) < 16 or buf[:12] != PROXY_V2_SIG:
        raise ProxyV2Error("missing or truncated PROXY v2 signature")

    ver_cmd, fam_proto, rem_len = struct.unpack_from(">BBH", buf, 12)
    if (ver_cmd & 0xF0) != 0x20:
        raise ProxyV2Error(f"unsupported PROXY protocol version byte: {ver_cmd:#x}")

    cmd = ver_cmd & 0x0F
    total_len = 16 + rem_len
    if total_len > len(buf):
        raise ProxyV2Error("truncated PROXY v2 address/TLV block")

    if cmd == 0x00:  # LOCAL
        return ProxyV2Header(True, None, None, None, None, total_len)
    if cmd != 0x01:  # PROXY
        raise ProxyV2Error(f"invalid PROXY v2 command: {cmd:#x}")

    block = memoryview(buf)[16:total_len]
    if fam_proto in (0x11, 0x12):  # AF_INET + STREAM/DGRAM
        if len(block) < 12:
            raise ProxyV2Error("AF_INET PROXY v2 block requires >= 12 bytes")
        src_ip = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(bytes(block[0:4])))
        dst_ip = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(bytes(block[4:8])))
        sport, dport = struct.unpack_from(">HH", block, 8)
        return ProxyV2Header(False, src_ip, dst_ip, sport, dport, total_len)

    if fam_proto in (0x21, 0x22):  # AF_INET6 + STREAM/DGRAM
        if len(block) < 36:
            raise ProxyV2Error("AF_INET6 PROXY v2 block requires >= 36 bytes")
        src_ip = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(bytes(block[0:16])))
        dst_ip = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(bytes(block[16:32])))
        sport, dport = struct.unpack_from(">HH", block, 32)
        return ProxyV2Header(False, src_ip, dst_ip, sport, dport, total_len)

    if fam_proto == 0x00:  # AF_UNSPEC
        return ProxyV2Header(False, None, None, None, None, total_len)

    raise ProxyV2Error(f"unsupported PROXY v2 family/protocol: {fam_proto:#x}")
```

def parse_alb_log_line(line: str) -> AlbLogEntry:
    raw = line.strip()
    tokens = [q if q != "" or raw_match.startswith('"') else bare for raw_match, (q, bare) in ((m.group(0), m.groups()) for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(raw))]

        raise ValueError("malformed ALB quoted request triple")
    method, url, proto = req_parts

        conn_type=tokens[0],
        timestamp=tokens[1],
        client_ip=client_ip,
        client_port=int(port_str),
        elb_status=int(tokens[8]),
        method=method,
        url=url,
        proto=proto,
        user_agent=tokens[13],

def parse_elf_pt_note(segment: bytes) -> list[ElfNote]:
